description: A rapidly growing benign vascular lesion that often develops after minor trauma or irritation.
causes: Reactive vascular proliferation; minor trauma can precede some lesions
risk_factors: Pregnancy can be associated with some lesions

appearance.general: A bright red or red-purple friable papule or nodule that may ulcerate or bleed easily.

warning_signs: Persistent bleeding or diagnostic uncertainty warrants medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss recent trauma, pregnancy, medications, and whether biopsy is needed for confirmation.
